findings.message: The purification step records only generic chromatography, omitting the silica gel stationary phase and specified petroleum ether/EtOAc eluent ratios. Preserve these conditions in unmapped_actions because the closed Purify schema has no dedicated fields for them.

value.reason: Purification uses silica gel with Pet. Ether (40‐60):EtOAc at the stated 19:1‐9:1 ratios; dedicated stationary-phase and eluent-condition fields are unavailable in the closed Purify schema.
